title: The Slap
issue: The 'died twenty years ago' line is strong, but the engraving and Adrian's warning arrive in one quick beat, so the question of who gave Lena the necklace is not fully sharpened.
fix: ADRIAN: (cold) Then explain how a Blackwood necklace ended up around a waitress's neck.
last_line: ADRIAN: (cold) Because the last woman who wore it died twenty years ago. In my house.

title: The Offer
fix: Adrian freezes, then looks at Lena and quietly pockets his phone, hiding the text from her.
last_line: Adrian freezes and slowly looks at Lena.

title: Settling In
issue: The opening is a passive walk-through, and the ending is a calm goodnight that releases tension instead of building it.
fix: She switches off the lamp, then freezes: Mrs. Hale's footsteps are stopping outside her door.
last_line: She smiles, turns off the lamp and goes to sleep.

title: The Ex Returns
fix: LENA: (whispering) Adrian... who knew I was at the hospital last night?
last_line: On the back: "Leave him. Or she stops breathing."

title: The Gala
issue: Victoria's toast line announces the reveal before the mugshot lands, which slightly weakens the surprise.
fix: Adrian lets go of her hand, then turns to Lena: 'Tell me the truth before she does.'
last_line: Gasps. Adrian lets go of Lena's hand.

title: Morning After
issue: The opening is mundane and the ending is a calm breakfast of relief, so the episode defuses the gala cliffhanger instead of extending it.
fix: Adrian slides his phone across the table: Lena's mugshot, plus a text from Victoria: 'Ask her who she is.'
last_line: They eat breakfast in silence. Lena sighs of relief.

title: The Hug
issue: The hug softens the ending, although the syringe reveal is strong.
fix: They hug, then Lena spots the empty syringe Mrs. Hale is carrying out the door.
last_line: They hug. Over Adrian's shoulder, Lena sees Mrs. Hale walking away with an empty syringe.

title: Confrontation
fix: Adrian stops mid-sentence, eyes locked on the syringe in Lena's hand.

title: The Explanation
issue: Lena accepts the explanation and says goodnight, which resolves the tension the episode built.
fix: LENA: (quietly) Okay. But Mrs. Hale said you chose me for a reason. Tell me that reason.
last_line: LENA: Okay. I believe you. Goodnight, Adrian.

title: The DNA Test
issue: 'It's time' is vague about what Victoria is planning, though the threat itself is strong.
fix: Victoria dials, and a voice answers: 'Mrs. Hale? It's time. Get Lena.'
last_line: Behind him, Victoria listens at the door and dials a number: "It's time."

title: A Quiet Day
issue: Calm opening and a nostalgic, resolved ending with no threat or open question.
fix: Mid-laugh, Adrian's smile vanishes as he stares past Lena at something across the estate. Cut to black.
last_line: Lena smiles. The camera rises over the beautiful estate.

title: The Will
issue: Strong gunshot opening and a sharp reveal ending; the shooter threat is dropped before the cliff.
fix: Before Lena can answer, the lawyer's window shatters again. Glass rains down. Cut to black.
